description.subtitle: Short short of the first Nike team of the Tottenham 2025 2026 player version - blue
description.tagline: He gives up like a professional with a unique style
description.intro: The Short Nike Tottenham Match 25 26 DFADV combines technical performance with club identity. Designed for those who live football to the fullest, its breathable fabric and comfortable fit make it an essential piece for any amateur.
key_benefits: Identidad de club: Colores y escudo oficiales de la temporada 25/26.
Technical performance: Fabric with advanced technology that regulates sweat.
Optimum fit: Ergonomic cut that adapts to movement.
Comodidad total: Material ligero y transpirable para largas sesiones.
Versatile Style: Perfect for training or cheering up your favorite team.
